meta.title: Earth and Life
meta.subtitle: Deep time: the geological eons, eras and periods, and the Phanerozoic extinctions
meta.description: The Earth's geological time scale from its formation, as the International Commission on Stratigraphy's eons, eras and periods, with the five Phanerozoic mass extinctions. A pilot: more events are to come.
meta.credits: Boundary ages and colour codes: International Commission on Stratigraphy, International Chronostratigraphic Chart v2026/06 (stratigraphy.org; © ICS, all rights reserved). Cite: Cohen, K.M., Harper, D.A.T., Gibbard, P.L. & Car, N. (2025, updated), The ICS International Chronostratigraphic Chart this decade, Episodes 48: 105–115. Extinction dates also from the English Wikipedia articles (dump of 1 November 2026) and Burgess et al. (2014).
